issues.description: The return type of Stock.getStockIngredients differs between the template and the solution. The template defines getStockIngredients() to return java.util.List<StockIngredient>, while the solution defines getStockIngredients() to return StockIngredient[]. The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not specify which return type is expected for this getter. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended getter signature and may cause tests or example code to fail depending on which form is assumed.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose a single, consistent return type for the Stock.getStockIngredients() getter and apply it across all artifacts. Prefer returning StockIngredient[] (to match the actual private field type) or explicitly document in the problem statement that the getter should return a List<StockIngredient>. Update the template and solution to use the same signature and update the problem statement to specify the expected getter return type.
